Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.transaction

Interface ModelTransaction

public interface ModelTransaction
A plugin-scoped, document-scoped write transaction. All write operations must be performed within an open transaction. Transactions are single-use: once committed or rolled back, the instance is invalid.

    • commit

      void commit() throws TransactionException
      Schedules and commits every queued command as the transaction operation.

      Providers that claim atomicity restore the captured state after partial failure; otherwise the thrown diagnostic reports the operation outcome. Editor-attached writes must integrate the native Undo, dirty-state, and required refresh path.

      Throws:
      TransactionException - if the transaction is closed, stale, denied, rejected, unsupported, or cannot commit

      Throws:
